incbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPEN — obs-gap detected for customer 'omega' (dedicated VPC pool). Missing traces and delivery of logs to customer workspace since 2026-04-23T08:23:00Z. Pager -> @Priya (oncall-ml). Incident INC-2026-0423-OMEGA-OBSV

Priya (oncall-ml): On it. What’s the initial signal? metrics, alerts, or customer report?

Aaron (eng-runtime): Customer CS reported missing traces and we see a sharp drop in span ingestion for tenant=omega at 08:23. Token delivery rates unchanged. No CPU/memory spike on pool nodes.

Aaron (eng-runtime): quick snippet from ingestion metrics: 
```
ingest.spans.count{tenant=omega} 08:10: 1200
ingest.spans.count{tenant=omega} 08:20: 1180
ingest.spans.count{tenant=omega} 08:23: 0
```

Jamie (sre): Any 403s or auth failures in forwarder logs?

Aaron (eng-runtime): yes — forwarder to customer log sink returns 403 from assumed-role operations. Got these in logs at 08:23:05: 
```
2026-04-23T08:23:05Z forwarder[omega] ERROR assume_role failed: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole
at provider/assume.go:87
```

Liz (infra): We rolled out an org-wide IAM tweak to tighten role trust yesterday 02:00 UTC. Might be related. Dedicated pools use cross-account assume_role to write to customer-managed buckets/traces.

Priya (oncall-ml): OK — likely root cause hypothesis: role trust change blocked forwarder from assuming tenant write role -> traces/logs stopped shipping to customer buckets. Customer-facing impact: missing spans and log lines since 08:23, no request denial for inference but observability is degraded.

Priya (oncall-ml): Immediate mitigation options — (A) re-open trust for the specific role for omega (fast but needs infra approval), (B) flip forwarder to use internal fallback sink (we have S3 backup) and reprocess backlog, (C) temporarily run re-forward job from our retention store. Which is quickest?

Liz (infra): I can short-circuit the role policy for omega via emergency ACL patch. Will need approval from infra lead. If we want fallback, Aaron can enable fallback flag on the forwarder.

Aaron (eng-runtime): I can flip fallback_to_s3 for tenant omega quickly. Command: 
```
# enable fallback immediately
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/omega/forwarder
payload: {"fallback_to_s3": true}
```
This will route spans/logs to our internal s3 sink then run a reprocess job.

Priya (oncall-ml): Do it. Also capture the failing request to include in escalation.

Aaron (eng-runtime): Done — feature flag toggled at 2026-04-23T08:29:12Z. Reprocess job kicked off: job id reproc-omega-20260423-01.

Aaron (eng-runtime): Reprocess logs show re-ingest starting, first batches showing positive counts.

Jamie (sre): Can you paste the health check result before/after?

Aaron (eng-runtime): before: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FWD_TOK" "https://vpc-forwarder.omega.internal/health" | jq .status
# => 403
```
after flip: 
```
# forwarder now accepting — fallback path engaged
curl -s "https://vpc-forwarder.omega.internal/health" | jq .status
# => OK
```

Olivia (cust-success): I’ve messaged the customer with a short update: "We detected an observability delivery issue affecting traces/logs for a short window. Our team is reprocessing backlog and will provide a timeline for completion in 15-30m." Customer replied: "Thanks — please confirm when full history restored."

Mark (acct): Need to check legal/contract if reprocessing includes any PSI. Is the fallback S3 internal-only?

Aaron (eng-runtime): The fallback sink is our internal encrypted S3 under Redwood-managed KMS — agreed with privacy, no customer PSI leaves Redwood.

Priya (oncall-ml): Handing off to Jamie (sre) and Liz (infra) for the next 45m to validate root cause and implement permanent fix (policy rollback scoped to omega or adjust forwarder to use service principal). I’ll stay on standby. Handoff note: timeline + actions below.

Jamie (sre): Taking lead. Immediate next steps: 
- confirm IAM change that caused sts:AssumeRole failure (Liz)
- run targeted role trust rollback OR create service principal for forwarder (infra)
- validate reprocess completion (Aaron)
- update customer timeline (Olivia)

Liz (infra): Confirmed — IAM tweak removed cross-account trust for role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-forwarder-omega. I’ll open emergency PR to restore trust for that role only, with audit log and expiry in 1hr. PR link: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/infra/1234 (pending), ETA 20m.

Jamie (sre): While infra works PR, set alert to watch for reprocess success and any duplicate deliveries. Aaron — can you add idempotency check on reprocess so customer doesn’t see duplicates?

Aaron (eng-runtime): Yes — reprocess includes dedupe by event_id; we’re good. Monitoring: reproc-omega-20260423-01 shows 95% batches succeeded at 08:40.

Olivia (cust-success): Customer update sent at 08:38 UTC: "We have engaged emergency mitigation; backlog reprocessing is in progress. Expected full restoration within 1 hour; will update if timeline changes." Customer acknowledged.

Jamie (sre): PR merged at 08:47, infra applied patch to restore trust. Verified assume_role calls succeeding in logs at 08:48:15.

Aaron (eng-runtime): Final validation: span ingestion for omega back to baseline by 08:52. No duplication, sample checks match.

Priya (oncall-ml): Marking incident as mitigated. Customer impact summary for postmortem: 
- Impact window: 2026-04-23T08:23:00Z - 2026-04-23T08:52:00Z (~29m)
- Impact: Missing traces and logs delivered to customer workspace for omega; no inference downtime, only observability gap
- Root cause: IAM role trust change rolled org-wide causing sts:AssumeRole failures from vpc-forwarder -> customer sink
- Mitigation: temporary fallback_to_s3 + reprocess, then scoped role-trust restore

Jamie (sre): Filing postmortem ticket and assigning owners for action items. Ticket: PM-INC-2026-0423-OMEGA -> https://tickets.redwood/inc/PM-2026-0423-OMEGA

Action items: 
- infra: add a deploy-time gating check to prevent trust removal for active tenant roles (owner: Liz)
- eng-runtime: add more graceful fallback auto-enable when assume_role fails >3x (owner: Aaron)
- cust-success: confirm customer saw full history restored and log closure (owner: Olivia)
- security: review cross-account trust changes process and add notification (owner: Mark)

Olivia (cust-success): I’ll follow up with customer and close loop once they confirm.

Priya (oncall-ml): Handing back to normal ops. Closing PAGER. If anything reappears ping me.

incbot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — status: resolved (mitigated). Closed at 2026-04-23T08:55:00Z.
